subject: Implement SQLite hardening and BEGIN IMMEDIATE retry helper
description:
Build `capo/memory/store.py` with: connection factory applying §7.3 pragmas at boot, a `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` retry helper per §7.3 contract (exponential backoff capped at `busy_timeout=5000ms`, raises `StoreUnavailable` on exhaustion), and a batched-insert helper for high-throughput chunk writes.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Pragmas applied at every connection: `journal_mode=WAL`, `synchronous=NORMAL`, `fullfsync=ON`, `busy_timeout=5000`, `journal_size_limit=67108864`, `foreign_keys=ON`.
- [ ] `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` retry helper retries on `database is locked` with initial 50ms, factor 2, jitter ±25%, capped at 5000ms wall time; re-raises as `StoreUnavailable` after exhaustion.
- [ ] Non-lock `OperationalError` propagates immediately without retry.
- [ ] Batched-insert helper accepts a list of rows and a flush trigger (count or interval) and uses parameterized queries.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Connection cleanup on caller error.
- [ ] Concurrent writers from multiple asyncio tasks coordinate without `SQLITE_BUSY` to user.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] `StoreUnavailable` is a typed exception with the failing operation context attached.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: pragmas verified after open
• Unit: retry helper backs off and retries on lock error, gives up at deadline
• Stress: parallel writers do not surface `SQLITE_BUSY` to caller (matches §6.1)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 6.1, 7.3 (Retry Helper Contract), 9.1
